_comment: Install metadata for the standalone hook scripts in this directory. Each key is a <name>.py here, wired by `claude-all ... coding hooks`. event = Claude Code hook event; matcher = tool-name regex (empty = all tools); timeout in ms. Symlinks install WITHOUT a kind prefix (<name>.py) and the settings merge dedups by basename, so re-install cleanly replaces a prior (incl. hand-wired) entry.
